subject: Security intake - hosting boundary & questionnaire selection (post-demo recap)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Howard <alex.howard@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security intake - hosting boundary & questionnaire selection (post-demo recap)

Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick post-demo recap and proposed next steps so we can move the security questionnaire work forward.

Recap (from today's call)
- Veridian Health is evaluating Redwood for clinical summarization & patient-facing assistants.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 Type II evidence required, BAA for PHI, and clarification on hosting/residency for any PHI flows.
- Preference stated for a CAIQ over SIG-Lite (team-level decision pending).

Clarifying questions / asks for us to finalize the questionnaire path:
1) Confirm whether Veridian intends to send PHI to the hosted API (vs. using Dedicated/Private). If PHI will be processed, we should treat this as HIPAA scope and prioritize BAA + Dedicated or Private options.
2) SOC 2: Do you need an in-scope report showing PHI processing controls, or will a standard platform SOC 2 Type II suffice?
3) Data residency: are EU residency requirements in play or is US-only acceptable?
4) Keys & encryption: Do you require customer-managed keys (CMK)/HSM integration for encryption-at-rest?
5) Evidence & timeline: What is your ideal timeline for receiving a prefilled CAIQ + evidence bundle?

What we can do next (suggested)
- We can prefill a CAIQ spreadsheet and attach primary evidence (diagrams, encryption details, SOC summary).
- If you prefer SIG-Lite instead, we can switch — tell us which form and we’ll prefill accordingly.
- Propose a 30-min follow-up (tech + security) to review the prefill the week of Aug 19; available windows: Wed 8/19 10:00-11:00 PT or Thu 8/20 9:00-10:00 PT.

Attachments: q3-demo-call-recording.mp3 (call recording).

Thanks — I’ll start the CAIQ prefill as soon as you confirm form choice and PHI scope.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

From: Alex Howard <alex.howard@veridianhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@veridianhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security intake - hosting boundary & questionnaire selection (post-demo recap)

Soojin — great recap, thanks. A few clarifications from our security team: 

1) SOC 2: We require a SOC 2 Type II report that covers the services that will process PHI. If Redwood's Hosted API processes PHI we need controls demonstrated for that scope. If the Dedicated/Private option is used and scoped, a standard SOC 2 Type II covering the platform may be acceptable but we need the evidence.
2) BAA: yes, we will need an executed BAA before any PHI goes to Hosted.
3) Residency: US-only is fine for now.
4) CMK: preferred but not mandatory; we'd like to understand whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) or bring-your-own-key.
5) Logs & retention: we retain audit logs for 13 months; please confirm typical retention and whether detailed request logs are available for export.

Form preference: Security prefers CAIQ (it maps to our internal control matrix). Please prefill CAIQ if possible. Evidence requests we will prioritize: encryption diagrams, key management docs, SOC summary, and any BAA template.

Ideal timeline: we need the prefilled CAIQ + evidence bundle by end of next week (Aug 24) to stay on our procurement calendar. Can you confirm?

Thanks — copying security (security@veridianhealth.com) for visibility.

Subject: Re: Security intake - hosting boundary & questionnaire selection (post-demo recap)

Alex — thanks, that helps a lot. Quick answers and next steps below.

Answers (short)
- PHI processing: we can support PHI on Dedicated or Private right away. Hosted API can be used for non-PHI production workloads; Hosted may be possible for PHI with a formally scoped BAA and Dedicated-backed tenancy depending on contract. I’ll flag this for legal.
- SOC 2 status: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II covering the inference platform and control environment (report summary attached). Full report release to customers is managed through our compliance portal — we can share the report (or redacted evidence) under NDA/portal access.
- CMK/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted CMK integration is on our roadmap but not yet GA.
- Logs & retention: default request logs retained 90 days in Hosted by default; Dedicated customers can configure retention and export. We can offer periodic exports for longer retention on request.

Next steps / deliverables from Redwood
- I will attach a SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf) and start a CAIQ prefill workbook (caiq-prefill-vernidian.xlsx).
- Jordan (cc'd) will own pulling encryption diagrams + KMS/HSM docs from the infra team; Karthik will coordinate any contract/BAA questions with Legal.
- Proposed follow-up to review CAIQ prefill: Wed 8/19 10:00 PT (please confirm). We can accelerate if you need the bundle by 8/24.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf, caiq-prefill-vernidian.xlsx

Soojin Lee
